name: B10-0530/2025 (ECR) – Post-election killings and the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks Tanzania to free opposition leader Tundu Lissu, who was arrested in April 2025 and charged with treason. It also asks Tanzania to stop using force against protesters, opposition figures, journalists and church leaders, and to release everyone held without clear legal grounds after the October 2025 elections.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only asks Tanzania to act.
- It affects Lissu, detained protesters, journalists and church leaders in Tanzania.
- The text is sent to European Union bodies and Tanzania's government and president.
